texts.value: Involved in nonsense-mediated decay (NMD) of mRNAs containing premature stop codons by associating with the nuclear exon junction complex (EJC). Recruited by UPF3B associated with the EJC core at the cytoplasmic side of the nuclear envelope and the subsequent formation of an UPF1-UPF2-UPF3 surveillance complex (including UPF1 bound to release factors at the stalled ribosome) is believed to activate NMD. In cooperation with UPF3B stimulates both ATPase and RNA helicase activities of UPF1. Binds spliced mRNA

Forms a trimeric UPF complex where UPF2 bridges UPF1 and UPF3B; UPF2 contacts the N-terminal CH-rich domain of UPF1 and the N-terminus of UPF3B (PubMed:18066079). The trimeric UPF complex interacts with the EJC core complex (PubMed:18066079). Found in a post-splicing messenger ribonucleoprotein (mRNP) complex. Associates with the exon junction complex (EJC). Interacts with SMG1, EST1A, UPF1, UPF3A, UPF3B, EIF4A1 and EIF1
